newsitem.title: USA: BPA cuts firm off-peak power 50 cents/MWh for Fri.
newsitem.headline: BPA cuts firm off-peak power 50 cents/MWh for Fri.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) again cut prices for next-day firm off-peak power by 50 cents per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Thursday.
BPA continued to hold off from offering firm or non-firm power during peak and shoulder hours.
Firm off-peak power was offered at $8.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Friday, down from $9.00 for Thursday.
For Friday, BPA offered displacement power at $8.50 from $7.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST.
Prices for non-firm power during off-peak hours on Friday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
